title: Pointwise pullback comparisons for the explicit tower
statement: Let $A,B,F,T,\pi,N$ and $X_i,\delta_i,e_i$ be the explicit functor-category tower [def-pc-cycle-pullback-tower-data-stage3]. For $b\in B$ and $i\leq N$, set $d=(\delta_{i+1})_b$, $f=d_{F(b)}^i$ and $g=\ker(d)\hookrightarrow X_{i+1}(b)\xrightarrow{(e_{i+1})_b}F(b)^{i+1}$. There is an isomorphism $c:X_i(b)\cong T(F(b)^i\times_{F(b)^{i+1}}\ker d)$ for which $c$ followed by $\pi$ and the first projection equals $(e_i)_b$, and $c$ followed by $\pi$, the second projection and kernel inclusion equals $(\delta_i)_b$. Only this explicitly constructed tower is quantified over.

proof.text: Identify the selected stage at i with the successor of the selected stage at i+1; at i=N the latter is the initial zero stage. The successor current functor is literally stepPullback followed by T.

Evaluation preserves kernels and pullbacks. Use PreservesKernel.iso for the next differential and pullbackObjIso for the cospan, then the pullback isomorphism induced by the kernel comparison and the proved degree transports. This identifies evaluation of stepPullback with the displayed pointwise pullback. Apply T.mapIso to obtain c.

Use naturality of pi to commute the comparison through pi. The pullback comparison equations for the first and second projections, together with the kernel comparison inclusion equation, give respectively the two displayed equations. Transport across the degree and next-term equalities. The zero initial stage is included in the same universal-property calculation.

proof_origin.place: Lemma 05T7 (1); explicit formalization in the abelian functor category by S3

lean.statement: theorem tower_comparison {A : Type u} [Category.{v} A] [Abelian A] {B : Type uB} [Category.{vB} B] (T : A ⥤ A) (π : T ⟶ 𝟭 A) (F : B ⥤ CochainComplex A ℤ) (N : ℤ) (b : B) (i : ℤ) (hi : i ≤ N) : let d := (differential T π F N (i + 1)).app b let f := (F.obj b).d i (i + 1) let g := kernel.ι d ≫ (augmentation T π F N (i + 1)).app b ∃ (c : (term T π F N i).obj b ≅ T.obj (pullback f g)), c.hom ≫ π.app (pullback f g) ≫ pullback.fst f g = (augmentation T π F N i).app b ∧ c.hom ≫ π.app (pullback f g) ≫ pullback.snd f g ≫ kernel.ι d = (differential T π F N i).app b
